verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a first-party writing-skills skill that 'teaches you to author and test new skills' through a TDD-style process, and documents where skills live, including the ~/.agents/skills/ cross-runtime path. A hands-on install also shows skills are plain markdown folders whose SKILL.md carries a `name:` frontmatter field. However, the evidence never shows an explicit fill-in template or documents the required name/description frontmatter schema, so authors may still infer the format from existing skills. Missing for 10: an explicit documented SKILL.md template, documentation of the description frontmatter field, and independent corroboration of authoring a new skill end-to-end.
